clock-timezone.tooltip: Search for a city or region, or pick Local to use this computer's timezone.

clock-schedule.tooltip: Card background color at a given time of day, interpolated between stops and wrapping over midnight. Tick Notify to pop a desktop notification when the clock reaches that time. Colors: hex (#rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa) or a name: black, white, red, orange, yellow, lime, green, teal, cyan, blue, purple, magenta, grey.

clock-smooth.tooltip: Blend gradually between schedule stops. When disabled, each color holds until the next stop and then jumps.

timer-minutes.tooltip: Default timer duration. The +/- buttons on the card adjust it by one minute while the timer is stopped.

timer-schedule.tooltip: Card background color at a given remaining time, interpolated between stops and holding the last stop's color beyond it. Colors: hex (#rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa) or a name: black, white, red, orange, yellow, lime, green, teal, cyan, blue, purple, magenta, grey.

timer-smooth.tooltip: Blend gradually between schedule stops. When disabled, each color holds until the next stop and then jumps.

timer-notify.description: Show a notification when the timer finishes
timer-notify.tooltip: Pops a desktop notification when the countdown reaches zero.

chrono-schedule.tooltip: Card background color at a given elapsed time, interpolated between stops and holding the last stop's color beyond it. Tick Notify to pop a desktop notification when the chronometer reaches that elapsed time. Colors: hex (#rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa) or a name: black, white, red, orange, yellow, lime, green, teal, cyan, blue, purple, magenta, grey.

chrono-smooth.tooltip: Blend gradually between schedule stops. When disabled, each color holds until the next stop and then jumps.

chrono-milliseconds.tooltip: Adds a .ss fraction to the chronometer. The card updates 20 times per second while it runs; paused it freezes the fraction, stopped it reads 00:00.00.

time-size.tooltip: Cards scale down from this size so the time stays inside the card

date-size.tooltip: Cards scale down from this size so the date stays inside the card

label-size.tooltip: Cards scale down from this size. Long titles ellipsize rather than overflowing

width.tooltip: Cards share the width. Each card needs about 130 px; when the width cannot fit them all, the chronometer and then the timer hide automatically and come back when you widen the desklet

reset-schedules.tooltip: Restores the clock, timer and chronometer color schedules to their default stops

timer-state.description: Do not change: persisted timer state
timer-state.tooltip: Do not change: persisted timer state

chrono-state.description: Do not change: persisted chronometer state
chrono-state.tooltip: Do not change: persisted chronometer state
